subject: Access to SOC 2 Type II — NDA & Bridge Letter
body:
From: Karen Liu <karen.liu@finsecure.capital>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: contracts@finsecure.capital
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: SOC 2 Type II access request

Hi Hannah,

We are evaluating Redwood for a PCI-adjacent feature and need to review your SOC 2 Type II report and supporting evidence. Our policy requires an executed NDA before we receive the report. Can you share your standard mutual NDA for countersignature?

Also please confirm: 1) the SOC 2 audit period you report on, 2) whether you can provide a bridge letter if the latest audit period doesn’t cover our assessment window, and 3) a short list of evidence artifacts you typically share under NDA (examples: control narratives, penetration test report, change control logs).

Target timeline: we are hoping to complete vendor review by Dec 10. Please advise estimated turnaround once NDA is received.

Thanks,
Karen Liu
Security & Vendor Risk
FinSecure Capital

---

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Karen Liu <karen.liu@finsecure.capital>
Cc: david.kim@redwood.com, jordan.blake@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II access request

Hi Karen — thanks for the note and the timeline. We can absolutely share the SOC 2 Type II report under NDA. I’ve attached a short intake spreadsheet (redwood-soc2-request-form.xlsx) to capture exactly which artifacts you need.

I’ve looped in David (Legal) and Jordan (Security) to confirm scope and the preferred countersign flow. We typically use a mutual NDA and exchange a bridge letter when the latest audit period ends before a customer’s assessment window. Our current audit period runs Jun 1, 2025 — May 31, 2026 (see note below).

Next steps from our side:
- We’ll send you the mutual NDA via DocuSign for countersignature.
- Once countersigned, we’ll provide a secure share (temporary Drive link with SSO/expiring access) to the SOC 2 PDF and any agreed artifacts.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Senior AE, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-soc2-request-form.xlsx (please fill and return)

---

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: jordan.blake@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 08:34:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II access request

Hannah — thanks. Agree mutual NDA via DocuSign is the fastest. A couple of legal notes to keep in mind when we share:
- NDA must explicitly permit receipt of third-party audit reports (SOC 2) and bridge letters.
- Limit sharing to named recipients at FinSecure; do not allow redistribution.
- Access window: default 30 days with option to extend by request.

I’ll prep the NDA template with those bullets and route through DocuSign. Jordan — flag anything else we should note about evidence handling?

David Kim
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

---

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Karen Liu <karen.liu@finsecure.capital>
Date: Tue, 16 Nov 2026 09:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II access request

Karen — sending the NDA via DocuSign now. You should receive a link shortly (DocuSign embedded link: https://app.docusign.com/embeddedSigning?token=abc123def).

We attached our standard mutual NDA (NDA_FinSecure_Redwood_20261115.pdf). Once countersigned by FinSecure, we’ll validate the signatories and grant a secure view-only share of the SOC 2 Type II PDF. If you need distribution to additional reviewers, let us know and we’ll update the NDA accordingly.

Estimated timing after countersign: 24–48 hours to provision access and upload artifacts.

Thanks,
Hannah

Attachment: NDA_FinSecure_Redwood_20261115.pdf (sent via DocuSign)

---

From: Karen Liu <karen.liu@finsecure.capital>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: security@finsecure.capital, contracts@finsecure.capital
Date: Thu, 18 Nov 2026 14:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II access request

Hannah — NDA countersigned and returned (attached stub). Thank you for the fast turnaround.

Two clarifications before you provision access:
1) Can you confirm the SOC 2 audit period covered by the report? We need the exact dates for our control mapping.
2) Because our assessment window extends into Oct 2026, please provide a bridge letter stating Redwood’s control posture changes (if any) since the audit end date, or a standard bridge letter confirming no material changes.

Please share the secure instructions for access and any restrictions (download disabled, watermarked PDF, expiry).

Karen Liu
Security & Vendor Risk
FinSecure Capital

Attachment: FinSecure_Countersigned_NDA_20261118.pdf (pdf)

---

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Karen Liu <karen.liu@finsecure.capital>
Cc: jordan.blake@redwood.com, david.kim@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 22 Nov 2026 15:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II access request

Thanks, Karen — received the countersigned NDA. Confirming audit period: Jun 1, 2025 — May 31, 2026.

We’ve attached a bridge letter (SOC2_TypeII_Redwood_2025-2026-bridge-letter.pdf) that confirms there have been no material control changes affecting the scope since the audit period end. Per our standard process:
- Access: view-only, watermarked PDF hosted on a secure Redwood Drive link; downloads disabled by default.
- Access window: 30 days from provisioning; we can extend by request.
- Named reviewers only: we will provision exactly the names you listed in the intake form.

Link and access instructions: https://drive.redwood.com/soc2-access/FS-Doc-Req-2026 (will be active once we provision).

If you’d like a short walk-through of the report and evidence map, Jordan is available for a 30-min call next week. Would Tue 11/30 or Wed 12/1 at 10am PT work?

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Senior AE, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: SOC2_TypeII_Redwood_2025-2026-bridge-letter.pdf (pdf), instructions-access.txt (text)
